items.quote: And God spake unto Noah, and to his sons with him, saying
items.claim: God spoke to Noah and his sons

items.quote: And I, behold, I establish my covenant with you, and with your seed after you
items.claim: God establishes a covenant with Noah and his seed

items.quote: And with every living creature that is with you, of the fowl, of the cattle, and of every beast of the earth with you; from all that go out of the ark, to every beast of the earth
items.claim: The covenant extends to all creatures from the ark
items.object: every living creature, of the fowl, of the cattle, and of every beast of the earth
